FILESYSTEM  (deny-by-default; every line is a grant, there are no deny rules)
  link   /bin -> usr/bin                                @sys
  dev    /dev                                           (snug)
  link   /lib -> usr/lib                                @sys
  link   /lib64 -> usr/lib64                            @sys
  proc   /proc                                          (snug)
  link   /sbin -> usr/sbin                              @sys
  tmpfs  /tmp (max 1 GiB)                               (snug)
  ro     /usr                                           @sys
  ro     /etc/group                                     @sys
  ro     /etc/ld.so.cache                               @sys
  ro     /etc/ld.so.conf                                @sys
  ro     /etc/nsswitch.conf                             @sys (optional)
  ro     /etc/passwd                                    @sys
  data   /etc/resolv.conf                               (snug)
  tmpfs  /home/u (max 1 GiB)                            @home
  data   /proc/config.gz                                (snug)
                     ← replaced with an EMPTY file — the host's copy is the
                       complete host kernel config — an exploit-selection oracle
  data   /proc/key-users                                (snug)
                     ← replaced with an EMPTY file — the host's copy is the host
                       user's keyring accounting
  data   /proc/keys                                     (snug)
                     ← replaced with an EMPTY file — the host's copy is the host
                       user's live keyring (keyctl is already seccomp-denied)
  ro     /proc/sys                                      (snug)
                     ← read-only: the write side is snug's own mount now, not a
                       capability check snug does not own. Reads are unchanged,
                       and namespace-scoped values are still this sandbox's
  tmpfs  /home/u/.cache (max 1 GiB)                     @home
  tmpfs  /home/u/.config (max 1 GiB)                    @home
  tmpfs  /home/u/.local (max 1 GiB)                     (snug anchor)
  tmpfs  /home/u/proj (max 1 GiB)                       (snug anchor)
  tmpfs  /home/u/.local/share (max 1 GiB)               @home
  tmpfs  /home/u/.local/state (max 1 GiB)               @home
  rw     /home/u/proj/sub                               @cwd-rw
  ro-/   everything else is a read-only skeleton (--remount-ro /)
                     ← (snug anchor) rows are snug's own empty tmpfs at an
                       ancestor of a grant. They hold nothing and grant nothing
                       — the payload could already write that path through the
                       tmpfs covering it — and they exist so it cannot rename
                       the path out from under a mount (issue #553).
